title: Identity normalization of natural Koszul-open evaluation
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\in\mathbb N$, and $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and $U=\bigcup_jD(f_j)$, and let $I_e$, $O$, and $u_e:I_e\to O$ be the derived sheaf Koszul tail, structure object and augmentation of [def-sc-koszul-open-system]. Let $R$ be derived restriction followed by the over-category equivalence. Assume derived categories for modules on $X$, on every over-open, on $U$, and for $A$-modules, with the universe parameters of the Lean statement. Put $H=H^0$ on $D(A)$ and $G=R\Gamma(U,-)$ as defined by affineOpenSections in [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. There exist equivalences $b_E:\operatorname{Hom}(R(O),R(E))\simeq H(G(E))$ for all $E\in D(O_X)$ such that $b_{E'}(\psi\,R(g))=H(G(g))(b_E(\psi))$. For every $e$ and $v:R(O)\to R(I_e)$ with $R(u_e)v=1$, $b_{I_e}(v)$ is the explicit identity-chain stage class [lem-sc-koszul-open-hom-chain-representatives], mapped by $H(Q(\iota_e))$ and then by $H(\operatorname{koszulCechDerivedComparison}(I_e))$ [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction]. This is solely a normalization on identity maps of the fixed Koszul tails, not a formula for maps to an arbitrary complex.

source.place: Proof of Proposition 36.9.5; Tag 08DC equation 36.9.4.1 and Tag 08D1 signed comparison; Tag 09M1 structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Take the natural family b and its one structure-object normalization from lem-sc-koszul-open-structure-evaluation. Fix e and the given left inverse v. Let z be the inverse image under b_(I_e) of the explicit identity class c_e. The equivalence identity says b_(I_e)(z)=c_e.

Naturality of b at u_e, the equality of augmented classes from lem-sc-koszul-open-augmented-identity-class and the normalization at O give b_O(z followed by R(u_e))=b_O(id). Injectivity of b_O gives z followed by R(u_e)=id.

The principal-unit theorem at exponent e+1 makes the over-restricted augmentation invertible. Identify its principal-open union with koszulOpen using basicOpen_eq_of_affine. The derived composition comparison and the over-equivalence transport this invertibility to R(u_e). Cancel R(u_e) to convert the given left inverse equation into a right inverse equation for v, and cancel it again to get v=z. Substitute into b_(I_e)(z)=c_e.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulOpenHom_identity_evaluation
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{v} (ModuleCat.{u} A)] :
    let R := ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace) (koszulOpen A r f)) ⋙
      Equivalence.functor
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
          ((moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace).over (koszulOpen A r f)))
        (D := SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (koszulOpen A r f).toScheme.toRingedSpace))
        (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv (koszulOpen A r f))).mapDerivedCategory
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0
    let G := (affineOpenSections A (koszulOpen A r f)).rightDerivedFunctor
    ∃ b : ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A)),
      (R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E) ≃ H.obj (G.obj E),
      (∀ (E E' : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (.of A))) (g : E ⟶ E')
        (ψ : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶ R.obj E),
        b E' (ψ ≫ R.map g) = H.map (G.map g) (b E ψ)) ∧
      ∀ (e : ℕ) (v : R.obj (koszulOpenStructure A) ⟶
          R.obj (koszulOpenObject A r f e)),
        R.map (koszulOpenUnit A r f e) ≫ v = 𝟙 _ →
        b (koszulOpenObject A r f e) v =
          H.map (koszulCechDerivedComparison A r f (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e))
            (H.map (DerivedCategory.Q.map (colimit.ι
              (koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
                (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
                  (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e))) e))
              (koszulOpenHomStageClass A r f (koszulOpenSheafComplex A r f e) e (𝟙 _)))
